title: UTFPR at SemEval-2019 Task 5: Hate Speech Identification with Recurrent Neural Networks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical application of Recurrent Neural Networks for a hate speech detection competition (SemEval-2019 Task 5). While it addresses harmful content (hate speech against immigrants and women), its primary objective is technical classification performance (F-scores) rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
